soundness_flags.label: def:ptall-design and thm:observable-completeness
soundness_flags.one_line: β is declared as a fixed vector in R^{d_A}, yet the construction and theorem require the X-indexed function β(x); declare β as a measurable vector-valued function and align the component normalization.

soundness_flags.label: ass:nuisance-estimability and thm:one-step-attainment
soundness_flags.one_line: “products of paired regression and propensity errors” does not name the pairs or give a rate for the estimated conditional covariance/pseudoinverse factors, so the stated condition cannot presently imply the displayed remainder.

soundness_flags.label: ass:fixed-covariance-rank
soundness_flags.one_line: Hansen (1982) treats finite unconditional GMM with nonsingular limiting covariance, not an X-conditional locally constant-rank pseudoinverse condition; retag and justify this instrumental rank-stability restriction or analyze rank-adaptive regularization.

soundness_flags.label: def:cbs-weighted-cells and prop:cbs-correspondence
soundness_flags.one_line: S is neither a component of O nor declared measurable with respect to X, while the weighted map evaluates ω(S); moreover no population-frame/inclusion law is defined from which a firm-population ATT follows.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:canonical-gradient; thm:one-step-attainment; thm:multiplier-bands
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The quotient projection is currently only the optimum in the specified marginal-score span; exhaustion of the full observed-data tangent-space complement remains open.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Any claim of the full Hájek--Le Cam bound, semiparametric efficiency, one-step attainment, or quotient-efficient bands is conditional on an affirmative solution of oeq:canonical-gradient.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the statistical experiment: make β an X-indexed nuisance, enumerate all nuisance-error products required by the one-step remainder, and include S in the observed law or define S as part of X together with an explicit population-frame inclusion model.

Replace the Hansen-labelled rank condition by either a novel, empirically motivated rank-stability regime or a ridge/rank-adaptive theorem that covers local singular values; this prevents the inference gain from resting on an unmotivated oracle-style restriction.
Obtain and cite the final Journal of Econometrics version of Bellégo et al.; give a page-and-equation crosswalk from its actual link system to F_U, F_T, W_B, and the strict quotient comparison.
Resolve the pattern-wise tangent-space adjoint question and prove the full canonical-gradient characterization, not merely the finite marginal-score projection.

recommended_next_step: Revise the four well-posedness/assumption defects and verify the Bellégo version-of-record crosswalk before advancing the quotient-efficiency angle to Stage 0.
